thread:
maria-ids: Heads-up — multiple EU university users getting default `user` role after SSO this morning, ~12 reports so far.

devon-eng: Any error logs from the identity proxy or JIT flow?

automated-log: Recent failures: `jit_provisioning: rejected - missing required attribute 'schacHomeOrganization'` (x12).

automated-log: sample assertion (trimmed):
```
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name:\"eduPersonPrincipalName\">alice@uni-eu.edu</saml:Attribute>
  <!-- schacHomeOrganization missing -->
  <saml:Attribute Name:\"mail\">alice@uni-eu.edu</saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```

lena-security: We added schacHomeOrganization as a required attr in the RBAC role-mapper mapping for edu partners last quarter. Seems Okta isn't releasing that attr for some federated IdPs.

maria-ids: Right — customers using older federation metadata from their IdP won't include schac. They still have eduPersonOrgDN or o:org attributes though.

devon-eng: Quick check: identity-proxy rejects JIT when any requiredAttributes are absent? Which config file?

maria-ids: config: `identity/rbac/mappers/edu-partner.json` -> `requiredAttributes: [\"schacHomeOrganization\"]` and `mapping: {\"schacHomeOrganization\": \"org_id\", \"eduPersonPrincipalName\": \"login\"}`

sam-sre: I'm seeing spikes in `role_assignments=default` metrics at 07:12 UTC. Rolling back to fallback mapping would fix live impact. Can someone craft a minimal hotfix? :wrench:

lena-security: Proposed short-term fix: remove schacHomeOrganization from requiredAttributes and add a fallback rule that derives org from `mail` domain if schac absent. That avoids silent JIT rejections.

maria-ids: Agreed. Also add a metric/log tag so we can alert when fallback was used (`rbac:org_fallback=true`).

devon-eng: Will prepare change: patch identity-proxy config and deploy to staging. Patch diff snippet:
```
- requiredAttributes: [\"schacHomeOrganization\"]
+ requiredAttributes: []
+ fallbackOrder: [\"schacHomeOrganization\",\"eduPersonOrgDN\",\"mail_domain\"]
```

sam-sre: Before prod deploy, can we also add an Okta admin checklist for partners: ensure attribute `schacHomeOrganization` mapped to `user.schacHomeOrganization` when available. I'll message SEs.

maria-ids: Also update our onboarding docs and the org-role mapping table so next time support can triage faster.

okta-bot: Note: Okta app config change request opened (APP-8342) to add attribute `schacHomeOrganization` for affected tenants.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for `identity-proxy` patch to staging (build 2026.03.20-identity-4321).

devon-eng: Staging looks good. Manual test: SAML assertion without schac now yields fallback log `rbac:org_fallback=mail_domain, mapped_org=uni-eu` and JIT provisioning succeeds.

sam-sre: Rolling to prod in 10m. Monitoring dashboards: `rbac.assignments.default`, `auth.jit.rejected`, `rbac.org_fallback_count`.

maria-ids: After prod rollout, please keep on-call loop open for 1h and tag any customer escalations — we'll proactively notify the affected EU partners.

lena-security: Follow-up action items: 1) revert requiredAttributes->schac requirement in main mapper, 2) add fallback/safe-derive logic, 3) update onboarding docs, 4) notify customers and SEs, 5) create an alert when >5 fallbacks/min. I'll own tracking.

sam-sre: Prod deploy done at 07:35 UTC, no increase in errors; `auth.jit.rejected` dropped to zero. Will keep monitoring 07:35–08:35.

maria-ids: Thanks team. Will open a postmortem ticket capturing root cause (IdP metadata variance) and recommended long-term: support multiple federation attributes and add a verification step during partner onboarding. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Deploy complete to prod (2026.03.20-identity-4321)

okta-bot: APP-8342 updated: Okta admin guide link posted (https://redwood.internal/docs/okta-saml-attrs).

sam-sre: Closing thread unless new errors surface.

maria-ids: closing — please ping if you see any late regressions.
